result.note: Tests the Codex adoption venue, Codex's FAO-WHO parentage and the India-hosted spices committee's Guwahati meeting.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Codex Alimentarius Commission adopted international quality standards for large cardamom, coriander and vanilla. Consider the following statements:
items: The standards were adopted at the Commission's session held in Geneva.
The Codex Alimentarius Commission is run jointly by the Food and Agriculture Organization and the World Health Organization.
The standards were finalised at a meeting of the India-hosted Codex Committee on Spices and Culinary Herbs in Kochi.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The third statement is wrong because the India-hosted committee finalised the standards at a meeting in Guwahati in October 2025, not Kochi. Codex sets food safety benchmarks that governments and importers reference, so harmonised standards ease market access for Indian spice exporters.
questions.source: The standards were finalised at the Codex Committee on Spices and Culinary Herbs, which India hosts, at a meeting in Guwahati in October 2025.
